items.title: Crescent City Crystals: Dave Bailey, Harold Christophe, Albert Delone, Sylvester Handy Interview, 1963-11-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You've been with Gibson a long while? Yeah. [INTERVIEWEE] Pretty good. I don't know what dad was, he died.

ctx.x: He died. How long have you been dead? Uh-huh.
So you've been with him a long while then? Hmm? You've been with Gibson a long while? Yeah.
Pretty good. I don't know what dad was, he died.
